bot_win_rates_note: 2p strategic vs greedy 0.43/0.57; both beat random by 92-98 points. Greedy is the stronger bot under cycle 1 rules.

cards.name: Size 1
cards.flag: Comet: in a winning orbit 61% less often than its deck share; Comet-vs-Giant never decides play (comet-blind margin 3.4 / 0.1 / 0.9)

cards.name: Size 5
cards.flag: Giant: 59% over-represented in winning orbits; captured only 0.1 times per game

ambiguities: Sideways bodies and the spin: the sim keeps the sideways mark on the card, so it moves with the spin (rules say so). Clear, but 'turn upright at Wake' must also cover a body that was spun into another slot meanwhile.
REBOUND on with SHIELD on: sim shields both launched bodies (rules say 'at most one sideways'; only an issue if Rebound returns).
Win check order at End: discard to 5 first, then pattern check; a discard never touches the orbit, so the order does not matter. Clear.
A body Recalled by a Launch was upright (Wake already stood it up), so a Recall never returns a sideways card. Clear.

Shielded body in a contact: the other body is also safe (contact does nothing). Also holds if the shielded body is the one that would have been captured by the opponent's winner of the other contact. Clear.

Long Night tie-break step 4 ('tied player who would take the next turn soonest, counting from the player whose Draw found the Deck empty'): sim counts the empty-Deck player as 0, so that player wins a full tie. Needs one word in the rules: 'including that player'.
'Equal Size: both go to Deep Space' - with a shielded body there is no crash, so two equal bodies can sit in contact; the sim allows it, no rule needed.
A player with no hand cards and an empty orbit slot can still spin; with every orbit empty the spin is skipped (unreachable after setup).
OPENING_2P=1: the first player's skipped Draw means 4 cards in hand, not 3 plus a draw; sim keeps the other 4 cards.
Spin of an orbit holding a single shielded body: legal, no effect. Strategic bots use this as a 'pass'. Not a rules problem, but 'must spin' is soft.
Hand limit 5 is checked in End only: a player may hold 8+ cards through opponents' turns. Clear.

problems.problem: The game is a 3-8 turn race, far under the 14-24 / 18-30 / 20-34 band (about 1.8 / 2.9 / 3.2 minutes at 0.4 per turn against the 12-minute target). Long Night fell from 95-100% to 0-0.1%, but the cure overshoots.
problems.evidence: headline 1,000 games per count: 4.4 / 7.2 / 8.0 mean turns; 2p minimum is the theoretical 3. Switch-off test: SHIELD off gives 22.6 / 33.7 / 30.4 turns; every other switch moves length by under 1 turn except WIN_AT_END (16.8 / 29.5 / 27.9 with 5-56% Long Night) and Rebound (2.3 / 4.4 / 5.5, worse).
problems.fix: The shield is the length lever: it lets a body build up untouched, so a 4-body pattern lands on a player's 2nd-3rd turn. Either drop the shield (then 2p fits at 22.6 turns, 3p/4p return to 83-87% Long Night, need a smaller Deck: untested) or keep it and start with 0 bodies (orbit empty; 8.3 / 14.8 / 18.3 turns, 2p still short). Best untested pair: opening 0 plus shield, plus +1 to every Critical Mass threshold.

problems.problem: Seat 1 has a large tempo edge at every count.
problems.evidence: seat gap 16.9 / 29.1 / 18.4 points (seat 1 wins 66.9% at 2p, 62.4% at 3p, 43.4% at 4p) vs the 5-point target. Falls to 11.3 at 2p with 1 opening body, 4.9 at 3p and 10.0 at 4p with 0 opening bodies; shield off at 2p is 5.5.
problems.fix: Short races always favour the first mover. Lengthening the game (problem 1) is the main fix. Cheap extra: the last seat draws 2 cards on its first turn, or the first player also skips Launch on turn 1.

problems.problem: The strategic bot loses to the greedy bot; skill expression against a real rival is negative (the studio check for a dominant simple strategy).
problems.evidence: strategic vs greedy: -14.0 / -8.0 / -13.1 points at 2/3/4p (vs random: +98.0 / +95.8 / +92.3; greedy vs random +95.8 / +93.0 / +91.9). Greedy mirror: Critical Mass wins 81 / 89 / 93% of pattern endings vs 27 / 34 / 40% in the strategic mirror. 'Take the biggest bodies' is the dominant plan; the other two patterns only pay off for a bot that plans them. Last cycle strategic beat greedy by +38 / +16 / -6.
problems.fix: Either Critical Mass thresholds up (17 / 16 / 15 tested only for 2p, where share falls 27% to 17% but length stays 4.6) or give Constellation and Alignment a lower bar than Mass in tempo, not just share. Treat as a race-length problem first: in longer games captures can punish a pile of big bodies.

problems.problem: Several twists are inert or nearly so: Recall, Comet beats Giant, the shield (as a skill), threat-aware spinning at 3-4p, and spinning others at 2p.
problems.evidence: ablation margins at 2/3/4p (need 5 or more): no-recall -1.8 / -1.9 / 0.0; comet-blind 3.4 / 0.1 / 0.9; shield-blind 7.2 / 1.1 / 3.3; threat-blind 8.0 / 4.4 / 1.2; self-spin-only 2.2 / 32.1 / 11.4; defence-check (a worse bot) 30.2 / 16.6 / 7.9. Giants are captured 0.1 times per game; Comets sit in winning orbits 61% less often than their deck share.
problems.fix: Rules cannot matter if games end before captures start (1.8 / 2.3 / 2.5 captures per game against the 15-25 band). Re-test the ablations after the length fix; if Recall and Comet-beats-Giant are still inert, cut Recall (it is also a line of rules).

problems.problem: Runaway leader and lead changes miss the KPIs at 2p; a 'threat' is almost impossible to break.
problems.evidence: orbit-total leader at the midpoint wins 74.7% at 2p (target 65%), 63.5% at 3p, 41% at 4p; lead changes 0.64 / 1.76 / 2.06 (target 2). Of positions one launch from a pattern, 83 / 79 / 77% are attacked, yet 100 / 61 / 48% are still one launch away at the owner's turn: at 2p a captured body is simply replaced by a hand card.
problems.fix: Lengthening the game (opening 0 gives 2.4 / 5.2 / 6.5 lead changes and runaway 0.80 / 0.50 / 0.33). A cheaper defence at 2p: captured bodies go to the attacker's hand AND the owner may not Launch into the slot just captured.

problems.problem: Constellation (rainbow) is the most common ending at 2p; Alignment drops to 21-23% at 3-4p.
problems.evidence: strategic mirror shares mass / const / align: 27 / 46 / 28 (2p), 34 / 45 / 21 (3p), 40 / 37 / 23 (4p), all inside 15-50%. Rainbow off: const 7% (dead), so the rainbow is needed. CM_BY_COUNT is inert (CM 15 everywhere: shares 37 / 34 / 29, length unchanged).
problems.fix: Keep the rainbow. The per-count thresholds are not worth a rule while games are this short.

problems.problem: Alternative arms do not help length.
problems.evidence: DECK40: 4.7 / 7.3 / 8.0 turns, Long Night 0 / 0.8 / 1.5%. CAPTURE_TO_DS: 4.7 / 7.3 / 8.1 turns, seat gap and runaway unchanged. DEEPSPACE_DRAW on: 4.4 / 6.9 / 7.9 turns (inert).
problems.fix: Drop both as length fixes; DECK40 only if the box size matters.
